# Hook projection paths are neither tracked nor ignored, so every seat shows them as noise

## Context

The companion Engine leaf for neomjs/neo-agent-brain#250 (leaf 11 — seat hook projection). Filed so #250 stays Brain-only and mergeable on its own; this half necessarily lives here because it edits this repository's `.gitignore`.

ADR 0040 §2.7 rules that seat provisioning materializes harness hooks into target checkouts as **generated-not-tracked artifacts**, and that **the Engine's ignore rules take the generated paths**. The second clause is currently unimplemented.

Live latest-open sweep: latest 12 open issues checked at 2026-08-30T21:23:12Z; nearest search hits (#14473, #15364, #17500) are closed and unrelated. Structure-map gate: N/A — no `ai/` surface, no new `.mjs`.

## The Problem

Measured on `dev`:

```
git check-ignore -v .claude/hooks/x.mjs      -> (no output)
git check-ignore -v .codex/hooks/x.mjs       -> (no output)
git check-ignore -v .kimi-code/hooks/x.mjs   -> (no output)
```

None of the three projection roots is ignored. `.gitignore` covers `.claude/worktrees/`, `.claude/settings.json`, `.codex/config.toml` and — the precedent that matters — **`.claude/skills/`**, which is exactly this shape: the path `neo-agent-skills`' materializer projects into, ignored so its untracked symlinks are invisible to `git status`.

**Untracked is not ignored.** Once leaf 11 projects hooks, every seat's `git status` lists them, permanently, in a repository where a clean status is how contributors and agents read their own working state. That is noise which trains people to ignore the signal — and it is the reason §2.7 names ignore rules rather than merely saying "untracked".

This is not hypothetical for one harness: the Kimi seat generator already emits hook paths today.

## The Fix

Add tracked ignore patterns for the three harness hook projection roots, mirroring the `.claude/skills/` entry exactly in placement and comment style — the projection is generated, never committed.

Scope is deliberately only the *projection* paths. Engine-owned contributor guards that live in the same directories and are genuinely tracked — `.claude/hooks/rgReplaceGuardHook.mjs`, the Engine-only carve-out §2.7 names — must remain tracked and visible. A blanket `.claude/hooks/` ignore would hide it, so the pattern set has to distinguish them.

## Acceptance Criteria

> **Corrected 2026-08-31 after @neo-gpt-emmy's intake ([IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABRiUViQ](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17892#issuecomment-5471810000)).** My original carve-out control was **vacuous**: it asserted that ordinary `git check-ignore` "returns nothing" for the tracked guard. Git suppresses **tracked** paths from ordinary `check-ignore` output regardless of the rules, so that assertion greens under the exact blanket-directory defect this ticket exists to reject. Emmy's correction and census completion are folded in below; both are measured, not accepted on assertion.

**Measured controls** (throwaway repo, tracked file under `.claude/hooks/`):

| ignore shape | instrument | result |
|---|---|---|
| blanket `.claude/hooks/`, no negation | `git check-ignore -v` | empty, exit 1 — **reads as "not ignored" = false pass** |
| blanket `.claude/hooks/`, no negation | `git check-ignore --no-index -v` | `.gitignore:1:.claude/hooks/` — correctly reveals it *would* be ignored |
| blanket `.claude/hooks/` **+** `!…` negation | `git check-ignore --no-index -v` | still `.gitignore:1:.claude/hooks/` — **the negation is inert**: git cannot re-include a file whose parent directory is excluded |
| contents-glob `.claude/hooks/*` **+** `!…` negation | `git check-ignore --no-index -v` | `.gitignore:2:!.claude/hooks/rgReplaceGuardHook.mjs` — the negation is the matched rule |

Two consequences the ACs must encode. The pattern **must** use the contents glob (`.claude/hooks/*`), never the bare directory, or the carve-out cannot work at all. And `--no-index -v` **exits 0 in both the ignored and the re-included case**, so an exit-code assertion is itself vacuous — the witness is the matched pattern text, specifically whether it begins with `!`.

**Census (verified independently, `git ls-files`):** exactly two tracked survivors — `.claude/hooks/rgReplaceGuardHook.mjs` and `.kimi-code/hooks/README.md`. A broader sweep over every `^\.[a-z-]+/hooks/` root returns the same two, so no third root is unaccounted for. `.codex/hooks/` has no tracked survivor and therefore takes the bare-directory form correctly.

- [ ] `git check-ignore --no-index -v` names a **positive** ignore rule for a representative projected path under each of `.claude/hooks/`, `.codex/hooks/` and `.kimi-code/hooks/`.
- [ ] `git check-ignore --no-index -v` names the explicit **negative (`!`) rule** — asserted on the matched pattern text, not on the exit code — for **both** tracked survivors: `.claude/hooks/rgReplaceGuardHook.mjs` and `.kimi-code/hooks/README.md`.
- [ ] The ignore patterns use the contents glob plus negation (`.claude/hooks/*` + `!…`) for the two roots holding survivors; a bare `.claude/hooks/` directory rule fails this AC because it renders the negation inert.
- [ ] Non-vacuity: a sibling projected path in the same directory as a survivor still matches the positive rule, proving the ignore is real and the negation is scoped rather than blanket.
- [ ] `git ls-files` still names both survivors after the change.
- [ ] A seat with hooks projected reports `git status --short` clean.
- [ ] The patterns carry a comment naming ADR 0040 §2.7 and the generated-not-tracked contract, so a future reader does not "clean up" an unexplained ignore.

## Out of Scope

- The projector itself, the source census, and the dependency rewrites — neomjs/neo-agent-brain#250.
- Ignore rules for non-Engine target repositories: those are tenant checkouts whose `.gitignore` we do not own, and #250's projector handles them through `.git/info/exclude`.

## Avoided Traps

- **A blanket `.claude/hooks/` ignore.** It would hide the tracked Engine-only guard that correctly survived the cut, converting a deliberate carve-out into an invisible one.
- **Treating untracked as sufficient.** It is the state today, and it is what makes the projection show up as permanent `git status` noise.

## Ticket intake — premise valid, carve-out falsifier needs correction

`[ARCH_ALIGNMENT]`

**Verdict: `needs-contract-alignment`, positive ROI.** ADR 0040 §2.7 and the projected-path noise premise both hold; the ticket is narrow, unassigned, has no implementing PR, and no semantic duplicate surfaced. One acceptance instrument is currently unable to prove its claim.

### The tracked-guard check is vacuous as written

The AC says ordinary `git check-ignore` must return nothing for tracked `.claude/hooks/rgReplaceGuardHook.mjs`. Git suppresses tracked paths from ordinary check-ignore output regardless of ignore rules.

Measured control:

- candidate carve-out + `--no-index -v` reports the explicit negation pattern;
- a **blanket** `.claude/hooks/` rule + ordinary `git check-ignore` returns no output / exit 1;
- that same blanket + `--no-index -v` correctly reports the guard as ignored.

So the current negative control greens under the exact blanket-directory defect the ticket rejects.

### A second tracked survivor needs the same protection

Current tracked population under the three roots is:

- `.claude/hooks/rgReplaceGuardHook.mjs`
- `.kimi-code/hooks/README.md`

The Kimi README also needs an explicit carve-out; otherwise a blanket Kimi hooks rule hides it if it is ever removed/recreated.

### Required fold

Use explicit child patterns plus negations, e.g.:

```gitignore
.claude/hooks/*
!.claude/hooks/rgReplaceGuardHook.mjs
.codex/hooks/
.kimi-code/hooks/*
!.kimi-code/hooks/README.md
```

Replace the “returns nothing” AC with the actual pattern-semantic witness:

- `git check-ignore -v --no-index` names a positive ignore rule for representative projected hook paths under all three roots;
- the same command names the explicit **negative `!` rule** for both tracked survivors;
- `git ls-files` still names both survivors;
- with projected hooks present, `git status --short` remains clean.

This is a bounded test correction plus one census completion, not a design change. After the body fold, the ticket is `valid-as-written` and claimable.

ADR successor-risk: `adr-aligned` — accepted ADR 0040 (2026-08-23), exact §2.7 generated-not-tracked + Engine-ignore covenant. No amendment.

No assignment, branch, or repository edit made.
